headline: Up to 20% off flights in the ixigo Festive Sale
description: ixigo's Festive Sale code gives up to 20% off flight bookings on the ixigo app or website. The sale runs till 9 Nov 2026.
how_to_redeem:
1. Open the ixigo app or website and search for a flight
2. Select your flight
3. Apply code FEST
4. Complete the payment
terms: Up to 20% off; offer void on full cancellation; ixigo T&C mention international flight bookings, so check the discount at checkout

headline: Flat 12% off domestic flights with AU Bank credit cards (Sundays)
description: Get flat 12% off up to 1000 rupees on domestic flights on ixigo when you pay with an eligible AU Small Finance Bank credit card. Valid on Sundays only.
how_to_redeem:
1. Log in to ixigo and search for a domestic flight
2. Apply code IXIAUD at booking
3. Pay with an eligible AU Bank credit card
terms: Sundays only; max 1000 rupees off; minimum booking 5000 rupees; AU Bank credit cards only (not debit, EMI or net banking); login required; not combinable

headline: Up to ₹2500 off domestic flights with IDFC FIRST credit card 3-month EMI
description: On ixigo, pay for a domestic flight with an IDFC FIRST Bank credit card on 3-month interest-free EMI to get 750 to 2500 rupees off, depending on the booking value.
how_to_redeem:
1. Log in to ixigo and search for a domestic flight
2. Apply code IDFCEMI3 at booking
3. Pay with an IDFC FIRST Bank credit card on 3-month interest-free EMI
terms: Minimum 5000 rupees; 750 off (5000-9999), 1000 off (10000-24999), 1500 off (25000-49999), 2500 off (50000+); EMI only, not full card payment; 1 booking per card per month; login required

headline: Flat 80% off hotels (up to ₹300) for select users
description: ixigo's FLAT80 code gives 80% off up to 300 rupees on Pay Now hotel bookings for select users on select properties.
how_to_redeem:
1. Log in to ixigo and search for a hotel
2. Choose a Pay Now rate
3. Apply code FLAT80 at booking
terms: Max 300 rupees off; Pay Now bookings only; select users and select properties; long-stay bookings only; domestic and international hotels; not combinable

headline: 10% off up to ₹250 + wallet credit on first bus booking
description: New redBus users get 10% off up to 250 rupees plus 10% cashback up to 250 rupees on their first bus ticket booking.
how_to_redeem:
1. Log in to redBus and verify your mobile number with OTP
2. Search and select a bus
3. Apply code FIRST at checkout
terms: First-time users only; minimum ticket 200 rupees; once per email/mobile; cashback credited to redBus wallet within 48 working hours after journey, valid 6 months
